protocol_edges: CPOL=0/CPHA=1: external MISO launches on rising SCLK; AD9361 captures MOSI on falling SCLK. CS is constrained against both first-rising setup and last-falling hold as a conservative periodic envelope. The 50-MHz controller input register is constrained without a CE multicycle exception; first-bit/last-bit framing still needs simulation and actual SPI identity acceptance.
device_reference: ADI AD9361 datasheet Rev. G and UG-570 SPI timing section: 1.8-V reference tCO=3..8 ns, input setup=2 ns/hold=1 ns, CS setup=1 ns/hold=0 ns. These are reference values, NOT a guaranteed 2.5-V PVT measurement.

board_assumptions.basis: An offline engineering envelope broadens the public 1.8-V tCO interval to 0..12 ns; this is not a guarantee at 2.5 V. If actual PVT/trace bounds exceed it, reduce the controller clock and reimplement rather than hide timing paths. Board SPI identity/PN tests and timing review remain required.
